title: JSON cache generic destructor callback

scope.rationale: VDBE auxiliary-data ownership now installs a source-shaped generic JSON cache destructor that releases copied input, parsed JSON owners, the entries array, and the cache object.
excluded_responsibilities: JSON cache insertion, lookup, and eviction

external_source_responsibilities: JSON parse release and VDBE auxiliary-data destructor invocation
dependencies.caller_closure: cacheInsert installs this exact callback on the production auxiliary-data slot.

outputs: All cache-owned memory released or null no-op
contracts.ownership: Consumes the cache and every entry's copied source and parse owner.
contracts.state_and_results: Entries are released before the array and parent cache.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Called by VDBE auxiliary-data cleanup; no direct I/O or lock.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and cannot fail.

representation_differences: The generic wrapper and typed cache deletion loop are consolidated in one nullable Zig callback.

oracle.protocol: Populate auxiliary JSON cache entries, replace or finalize the statement slot, and compare all copied-source and parse-owner releases.

assurance.oom: The destructor allocates nothing and runs after partial cache population.
assurance.malformed_input: Null is accepted; non-null requires the installed cache type.
assurance.continuation: Auxiliary-data slot cleanup completes without callback error.
assurance.performance: Linear in at most four cache entries.

integration.native_call_path: cacheInsert -> setAuxData -> statement auxiliary cleanup -> cacheDeleteGeneric

independent_review.notes: Focused allocator trace and review remain open.

known_blockers: Add focused auxiliary-data replacement/finalize differential and independent review.

implementation_spans: Complete source jsonCacheDelete and generic wrapper region
Production cache insertion and auxiliary-data owner
assertions_branches_cleanup: Null, empty cache, populated cache, replacement, and finalize cleanup reviewed
upstream_tests: Project JSON and broad runtime tests
